changelog: - **An instant call from a project's group chat is gated on the projects module** (#2504, split out of #2503). `POST /api/meetings/instant` ran `requireCapability(orgId, 'projects')` only when the request body carried a `projectId`, and a call started from a project's group room carries `conversationId` instead — so the module was closed for *creating* that room (`POST /api/conversations` has always been gated) and open for holding a call in it. The room's own project is knowable only once the meeting context resolves, so `resolveMeetingContext` now reports it as `owningProjectId`, deliberately separate from the context's `projectId`: a meeting still hangs off exactly ONE context (#1051), so the row is written with `projectId: null` as before and only the gate reads the owning project. Null for a RELATION and for a DIRECT chat, both of which are core mentorship rather than the projects module. The gate itself sits after the context resolves and before the room link is resolved or anything is written, and skips the work when the body-level gate has already covered the same project. Covered in `e2e/vertical-write-gate.spec.ts` by a pair the empty-POST table cannot express: a MARKETING org is refused with `capability_unavailable` and writes neither a `Meeting` nor the chat line, and an INTERNSHIP org makes the identical call successfully.

en: Organizations whose plan does not include the projects module can no longer start a video call from a project group chat.
tr: Planında proje modülü bulunmayan kuruluşlar artık proje grup sohbetinden görüntülü görüşme başlatamıyor.
de: Organisationen, deren Tarif das Projektmodul nicht enthält, können keinen Videoanruf mehr aus einem Projekt-Gruppenchat starten.
